title: List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for comm
question:
List all the card id and artist with unknown power which are legal for commander play format.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: unknown power refers to power = '*' or POWER IS NULL; commander play format refers to format = 'commander'; legal for commander play format refers to format = 'commander' where status = 'Legal'

prediction.sql: SELECT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002 FROM cards AS "c" JOIN legalities AS "l" ON "c".XCL_072 = "l".XCL_086 WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'commander' AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal' AND (c.XCL_055 = '*' OR c.XCL_055 IS NULL)

arguments.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE l.XCL_084 = 'commander'
  AND l.XCL_085 = 'Legal'
  AND (c.XCL_055 = '*' OR c.XCL_055 IS NULL);
